text:
jen_acme: Hey team — after yesterday's model rollout our summarization endpoint (model: rwd-3b-chat, rolled @2026-03-10 02:10 UTC) started returning factually incorrect summaries for a large subset of our docs. Examples below. This is affecting prod traffic. Please advise.

jen_acme: Example 1 (input id: input-7f9, request_id: abc123):
User text: "Q: When was the company founded? A: ???"
Expected: "Founded 2014"
Got: "Founded 2017, after pivoting to mobile"

jen_acme: Example 2 (input id: input-9b2, request_id: def456):
Prompt we send (simplified):
```
system: You are a concise summarizer.
user: Summarize the section about company history.
```
Output now includes invented events and wrong dates. We didn't change prompts.

maya_cs: Sorry about this — escalating. Can you confirm: are you using Hosted API (api.redwood.ai) or Dedicated? Also which exact model string+version are you calling in the header?

jen_acme: Hosted API. We pass `model: rwd-3b-chat` in the body, no explicit version tag. Traffic is mixed but most hits hit hosted.

maya_cs: Thanks. Could you also share the full raw request (including system prompt and top-level message array) and a sample response (raw JSON) for one or two failing requests? If you can redact PII that's fine. Also include the `x-request-id`/`request_id` header you got from the response.

jen_acme: Pasted sample (redacted):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{ "model": "rwd-3b-chat", "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise summarizer."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: ..."}], "temperature": 0.0 }
Response headers: x-request-id: abc123
Response body: { "id":"resp-1","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Founded 2017 after pivot"}}] }
```

liam_eng: tagging in. @maya_cs thanks for the details. Quick checklist:
- Did this start immediately after the rollout window?
- Any customer-side prompt injection or new filter middleware between you and our API?
- Did you pin to a specific version earlier?

jen_acme: It started ~30–45m after we noticed the 02:10 UTC deploy. No client-side changes. We did not pin versions.

nora_ml: Could be a model behavior drift after we pushed new weights/decoding defaults. @liam_eng, do we have the rollout manifest for rwd-3b-chat v2.3.0? Also, we should ask customer for minimal repro: exact messages array + model + temperature + streaming flag. If they can run a single curl and paste output that helps a ton.

maya_cs: Jen, can you run this minimal repro locally and paste the full response (including headers)? Replace your doc with a short excerpt that reproduces the issue. Example curl: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b-chat","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise summarizer."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: Our company started in 2014 and..."}],"temperature":0.0}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -D -
```
Include the response headers (for request ids).

jen_acme: Running now, sending output. Headers show `x-request-id: ghi789` and body shows the hallucinated date again. Pasting below.

jen_acme: (response headers)
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-request-id: ghi789
content-type: application/json
```
(response body)
```
{ "id":"resp-2","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Founded 2017 after pivoting to mobile"}}] }
```

liam_eng: thanks — that's helpful. @nora_ml I'm pushing the request ids (abc123, def456, ghi789) to the logs pipeline. Can you check model trace for those request ids and the timestamp window ~02:10–03:00 UTC? Also, can infra confirm which kernel/quantization profile was used for those served instances?

deploy-bot: Deployment rwd-3b-chat:v2.3.0 progressed to 100% at 2026-03-10T02:10:12Z.

nora_ml: I see an uptick in unexpected factual errors correlated with the v2.3.0 rollout. Initial diff indicates a changed temperature/penalty default in the decoding config dropped from `presence_penalty: 0.0` to `presence_penalty: -0.3` in compilation layer (unintended). Negative presence penalty can encourage inventing new tokens.

nora_ml: Action items:
1) eng to rollback or patch decoding config ASAP (liam)
2) customer to produce a minimal reproducible example (one curl) with `temperature=0.0` and `stream=false` and paste raw response
3) ML to run an internal eval across our summarization eval set to quantify regression

liam_eng: I'll open a rollback PR. Quick mitigation: we can pin Hosted to v2.2.1 for traffic from affected customers. Maya — can you confirm if Acme wants immediate pin/rollback or they prefer us to patch?

maya_cs: Jen, we can pin you to v2.2.1 immediately (no customer action) and then run the full investigation. Which do you prefer?

jen_acme: Please pin to v2.2.1 ASAP. We need to stop bad outputs hitting end users. Thanks.

liam_eng: Roger — rolling pin for account `acme_inc` to rwd-3b-chat:v2.2.1 now. Deploy-bot will post when complete.

deploy-bot: Rolled back rwd-3b-chat to v2.2.1 for account acme_inc at 2026-03-10T03:00:12Z.

nora_ml: I'll run the eval and post the regression numbers once available. Maya — when you confirm the customer sees improved outputs after pin, we'll keep the case open and parallel-run the patch.

maya_cs: Jen — can you confirm after a few minutes whether responses match expected? Also please share a few more failing examples if you have them (helps ML). :pray:

jen_acme: After pin, we see correct summaries again. Thank you. I'll gather ~5 more failing examples and send over.

liam_eng: Logged ENG-1219 for rollback + root cause. Leaving this thread open for additional examples and the ML regression report.

nora_ml: Preliminary eval: on our summarization benchmark, v2.3.0 shows a 7.8% increase in factual error rate vs v2.2.1 at temperature=0.0. Will attach full diff once processed.

maya_cs: Great work everyone. Jen — thank you for quick repro and patience. We'll keep this thread updated with the postmortem and remediation steps. :thumbsup:
